content.instruction: Write a job application. You are applying for a Secretary-General position at NATO. Tell about your experience in security policy, transatlantic relations, and crisis management. Describe your vision for NATO's future and its role in the European security architecture. Also reflect on how you would strengthen alliance unity and respond to new security threats. Length about 450 words.
